en: n. a smooth and attractive way of moving; a polite and kind manner; extra time given to pay a bill; a short prayer said before a meal; vt. to make something look more attractive
ex: She moved across the stage with grace.
她優雅地走過舞台。

en: n. a condition that makes success more difficult; something that makes a situation worse; a disadvantage in which someone is not given the same chance
ex: One disadvantage of living in the city is the noise.
住在城市的一個缺點是噪音。

en: n. an act of saying goodbye; a party or event held to say goodbye to someone; interj. a way of saying goodbye; a. said or done when someone is leaving
ex: They held a farewell party for their retiring teacher.
他們為即將退休的老師舉辦了歡送會。

en: n. something that you can choose; the freedom to choose; a right to buy or sell something at a particular price; a subject you can choose to study
ex: You have the option of paying by credit card or in cash.
你可以選擇用信用卡或現金付款。

en: a. liking traditional ways and not wanting change; (of an estimate) lower than the actual figure to be safe; relating to a conservative political party; n. a person who supports traditional values
ex: My grandfather is quite conservative in his views.
我爺爺的觀點相當保守。

en: n. a period when business and the economy are doing badly; a feeling of deep sadness; a hollow place in a surface
ex: The country fell into a deep economic depression in the 1930s.
該國在 1930 年代陷入了嚴重的經濟蕭條。

en: a. having many mountains; very large, like a mountain
ex: The country is mostly mountainous with few flat areas.
這個國家多山，平地很少。

en: n. a refusal to accept something; the ability to avoid being affected by something; a force that slows something down; (physics) the opposition to the flow of electric current
ex: There was strong resistance to the new tax plan.
新的稅收計畫遭遇強烈反對。

en: a. violent and angry in a way that could hurt someone; very strong or intense; (of competition) very intense
ex: A fierce storm swept across the island last night.
昨晚一場猛烈的暴風雨掃過這座島。

en: vi. to fall down or break apart suddenly; to fail completely; to fall down because of weakness or illness; n. the sudden failure of something; the fall of a building; vt. to fold something so that it takes up less space
ex: The old bridge collapsed after the heavy rain.
那座舊橋在大雨後倒塌了。

en: n. an idea or feeling that you have about someone or something after seeing them; the effect that something has on someone; a mark made by pressing something into a surface; a funny imitation of a famous person
ex: He made a good impression on the interviewer.
他給面試官留下了好印象。

en: n. a very small jumping insect that lives on the skin of animals and people and feeds on their blood
ex: The dog scratched itself because it had fleas.
那隻狗因為有跳蚤而一直抓癢。
ph: send someone away with a flea in the ear

en: a. lacking knowledge or information about something; showing a lack of knowledge; impolite because of a lack of knowledge
ex: He was completely ignorant of the danger.
他完全不知道有危險。

en: a. relating to money, especially to the management of money by governments, companies or individuals
ex: She is having financial difficulties after losing her job.
她失業後遇到了經濟困難。

en: n. a part of a machine that changes the speed or direction of movement; clothes or equipment used for a particular activity; a particular position of the gears in a car; vt. to make something suitable for a particular purpose; vi. to connect or work with something
ex: He shifted into second gear as the car went up the hill.
車子爬坡時他換成二檔。

en: a. exactly the same as someone or something else; (of twins) developed from one egg; the same
ex: The two sisters are identical twins.
這兩位姐妹是同卵雙胞胎。

en: a. unpleasantly rough or hard; cruel or severe; (of weather) unpleasantly cold or harsh; (of sounds or colors) unpleasantly strong
ex: The winter was harsh and many animals died.
那年冬天很嚴酷，許多動物死了。

en: a. easily seen or understood; seeming to be true although it may not be; clear and obvious
ex: It was apparent that she was not happy with the decision.
很明顯，她對這個決定不滿意。

en: n. a way of pronouncing words that shows where someone comes from; a mark above a letter; the extra force given to a word or syllable; vt. to give extra force to a syllable or word; to emphasize something
ex: She speaks English with a French accent.
她說英文帶有法國口音。

en: n. a tool with a flat blade and a handle, used for digging; one of the four suits in a pack of cards; vt. to dig with a spade; vi. to dig
ex: He dug a hole in the garden with a spade.
他用鏟子在花園裡挖了一個洞。

en: vt. to bring people together in one place; to put together the parts of something; vi. to come together in a group
ex: The workers assemble the cars on the production line.
工人在生產線上組裝汽車。

en: a. lucky; having good luck; happening because of good luck
ex: We were fortunate to find a hotel room during the festival.
我們很幸運在慶典期間找到了旅館房間。

en: n. a state of complete quiet; vt. to make someone or something stop talking or making noise; to keep something secret; interj. used to tell someone to be quiet
ex: A hush fell over the room when the teacher walked in.
老師走進來時，房間裡一片寂靜。

en: n. the basic laws of a country that state the rights of people and the powers of government; the physical condition of a person; the way something is formed
ex: The constitution gives every citizen the right to vote.
憲法賦予每位公民投票的權利。

en: vt. to prepare and produce a book, newspaper or other material for sale; to make information known to the public; vi. to have your work printed in a book or journal
ex: The company will publish her first novel next year.
出版社明年將出版她的第一本小說。

en: n. a person who is not in the army, navy or police force; a person who is not a member of the armed forces; a. relating to ordinary people and not the military
ex: Many civilians were injured during the fighting.
許多平民在戰鬥中受傷。

en: v. to give the main points of something in a short form; to briefly describe the main ideas of something
ex: Please summarize the story in three sentences.
請用三句話概述這個故事。

en: n. the remains or traces of a plant or animal preserved in rock; (informal) an old-fashioned person; a. relating to fossils or very old
ex: The scientists discovered a fossil of a dinosaur in the desert.
科學家在沙漠中發現了一具恐龍化石。

en: vt. to change something in order to make it better; to study again for an examination; to correct something to take account of new information; n. a corrected version of a piece of writing
ex: I need to revise my essay before I submit it.
我交出去之前需要修改我的論文。

en: a. pleasant and enjoyable; willing to agree to something; (of a person) friendly and nice
ex: She is an agreeable person who is easy to work with.
她是個隨和的人，很好共事。

en: n. a business that provides a particular service; a government department that does a specific job; the power or means to do something
ex: She works for a travel agency in the city.
她在市區的一家旅行社工作。

en: n. the act of doing or saying something again; something that is repeated; the act of learning something by saying it again and again
ex: Learning a language needs a lot of repetition.
學語言需要大量的重複練習。

en: n. a pleasant idea that you imagine but is unlikely to happen; a story with magic or imaginary creatures; the ability to imagine things; a. imaginary
ex: The little girl lives in a world of fantasy.
那個小女孩生活在幻想的世界中。

en: a. the smallest or lowest possible amount; n. the lowest amount or level possible; the smallest amount needed
ex: The minimum age to drive is eighteen.
開車的最低年齡是十八歲。

en: n. the main subject or idea in a piece of writing, a speech or a work of art; a repeated pattern of notes in music; the subject of a party or event
ex: The theme of the story is about friendship and trust.
這個故事的主題是友誼與信任。

en: a. relating to a tribe; connected with the traditions and customs of a tribe; showing strong loyalty to one's own group
ex: The tribal leaders met to discuss the problem.
部落領袖們聚在一起討論這個問題。

en: n. a number or amount expressed as a part of one hundred; a part or share of a whole; the likelihood that something will happen
ex: A high percentage of students passed the exam.
很高比例的學生通過了考試。

en: vt. to bite food into small pieces in your mouth before swallowing; vi. to think about something carefully for a long time; to keep biting something; n. the act of chewing; something that is chewed
ex: You should chew your food slowly.
你應該細嚼慢嚥。
ph: bite off more than one can chew

en: n. the act of leaving a place; a change from what is usual or expected; the point at which a vehicle leaves; a new direction
ex: Please be at the airport two hours before departure.
請在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

en: n. a long period of time marked by a particular feature or event; a period of history; a set point in time from which events are dated
ex: We are living in a new era of technology.
我們正生活在科技的新紀元。
